items.unit: PLN per complete package ex-VAT (TRANSACTION: contract value)
items.basis: Odlewnie Polskie S.A. (Starachowice, listed on GPW) current report: contracts signed 20 Feb 2024 with Heinrich Wagner Sinto (horizontal-parting automatic green-sand moulding line), Jöst and Induga (induction melting) for a moulding line and related equipment, total EUR 8.86 M net; the filing gives ≈ 38.44 M PLN at the NBP rate of 19 Feb 2024; at the book rate 8,860,000 × 4.374 = 38,753,640 PLN. Purpose: capacity 19,500 → 23,500 t castings/yr (+4,000 t). 18-month project, own funds.
items.notes: A real Polish automotive-type iron foundry contract (Świętokrzyskie, not one of the four clusters, but national prices). NOT like-for-like with the library's 'Sand Casting Moulding Line' (book implied capex 573,300 PLN, 110.95 PLN/h): this is a complete automatic HWS line PACKAGE including melting (Induga) and Jöst equipment, sized for thousands of tonnes a year. It shows that an automatic green-sand moulding line in Poland costs tens of millions of PLN — 67× the book's figure — so the book's sand-cast-line capex can only represent a small/manual unit. Decide which machine the library means before using; do not drop 38.8 M PLN onto a 573k PLN rate without that decision. 2024 price (no 2026 figure found).

notes: 30 web searches used (round-2 budget). WebFetch refused (ENOTFOUND) for every host incl. bazakonkurencyjnosci.funduszeeuropejskie.gov.pl, so EU-funded tender documents could not be opened; Baza Konkurencyjności inquiries for press brakes (WEMECO 2025, Standis FENG 2024, DEKO-TECH FEMP 2023), a fibre laser (Plex Gliwice FESL 2025) and robot welding cells (Fortaco, Unidex) were found but none showed an awarded net value in the search results.
Current-book implied capex = buildupPln.financeCost ÷ 2% (book: 4% on half the capex) from current-poland-book.json.

Pattern: for sheet-metal cutting/bending the book's capital (UK × 0.72) looks HIGH, not low — TruBend 3100 new EUR 136k = 0.59 M PLN v book 2.38 M; a complete XPR300 plasma table ≈ EUR 135k (seller-stated) = 0.59 M PLN v book 1.38 M; KUKA spot-weld cell book 6.97 M PLN v blog band 0.3–1.0 M; press-aida-200t / press-schuler-400t at 6.4 M / 7.3 M PLN look like lines, not presses. For foundry lines the book looks LOW: a Polish automatic HWS moulding line package cost EUR 8.86 M (38.8 M PLN, Odlewnie Polskie ESPI, Feb 2024) v book sand-cast-line 0.57 M PLN (different scope — see item).

The 'notRebuiltBasis' line in build-config.py says held capital 'likely UNDERSTATES' Polish plant; that is true for Haas-class CNC (round 1) but the evidence here says it OVERSTATES premium sheet-metal machines — the held capital should not be described as one-directional.
